Routine du 5/11 sur BLEO : jauge 1 full test et 7 déclinaisons ; j'ai fait 2 full tests et 6 déclinaisons (lignes 2 à 7 de la boîte), car les autres lignes ne se déclinent pas proprement : 1 (083ac272, 9 hobbies « validés par la science », des preuves que je ne peux pas vérifier, et le label évite la liste « prouvée par la science » vague), 8 (837491f7, faute de frappe et salaires), 9 (6211e51e, « other then »), 10 (9e0c287f, « je notes… j'ai essayé », fautes à recopier). slides.texte_overlay: how to make waking up easier

1. lay out tomorrow the night before

clothes, bag, breakfast.
fewer decisions, easier mornings.

2. pick a song you only play when you wake up

after a week, it feels like a start signal.

3. give your brain something fun first

this morning i learned that napoleon wasn't actually short. he was about average height for his time.
i woke up arguing with history.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. give your brain something fun first

this morning, the Sophia app taught me that napoleon wasn't actually short. he was about average height for his time.
i woke up arguing with history.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. make your bed with you still in it

pull the covers up, roll out.
now going back is too much effort.

5. have something to look forward to

a good coffee, a new chapter,
a walk before class.
